{% autoescape off %}# HolidayOps

> HolidayOps answers "is this date a working day?" for {{ country_count }} countries and {{ region_count }} regions. It combines public holidays, each country's own weekend and a company's own closures, and serves the answer through a REST API, iCal feeds, email digests and signed webhooks. The web app and public pages are in English, Urdu and Arabic.

Holiday data comes from the open-source Python library `holidays` (https://github.com/vacanza/holidays). HolidayOps is open source under the MIT License and built by {{ owner }} ({{ owner_url }}). Support: {{ support_email }}.

## Pages

- [Home]({{ root }}): what HolidayOps does, a live "is it a working day?" check, who is off today
- [Public holidays by country]({{ root }}holidays/): every supported country, one page per country and year
- [Pricing]({{ root }}pricing/): Free (no card) and Pro (US${{ pro_price }} a month), and how requests are counted
- [Guide]({{ root }}guide/): step-by-step instructions for beginners, from the first date check to the API
- [Who is off today]({{ root }}today/): every country's holidays on its own local date
- [Overlap tool]({{ root }}tools/overlap/): the shared working days of up to four countries
- [Status]({{ root }}status/): live health of the API, database and background jobs
- [About]({{ root }}about/): why the project exists and who builds it
- [Contact]({{ root }}contact/): support, Pro plans, wrong dates and security reports

## API

- [Interactive API docs]({{ root }}api/v1/docs/): Swagger UI for every endpoint
- [OpenAPI schema]({{ root }}api/v1/schema/): machine-readable OpenAPI 3 description
- [Full reference for language models]({{ root }}llms-full.txt): endpoints, parameters, limits, accounts and every country code in one text file

## Web app

- [Playground]({{ root }}playground): pick a country and click a day; no account needed
- [Sign up]({{ root }}signup): free account, confirmed by a 6-digit code sent to the email address
